name: 45 Park Lane
positioning: Art Deco-style Dorchester Collection hotel on Park Lane in Mayfair, overlooking Hyde Park, with a contemporary British art collection, CUT by Wolfgang Puck and Sushi Kanesaka
best_for: Travelers who want a Mayfair base with rooms facing Hyde Park
Art lovers drawn to contemporary British art
Diners keen on omakase sushi or an American steak restaurant

facts.text: 45 Park Lane is on Park Lane in Mayfair, overlooking Hyde Park.
Hyde Park is a 3-minute walk from the hotel.
The hotel is close to Buckingham Palace, the Royal Academy of Arts and Wellington Arch.
The hotel was designed by Thierry Despont in a warm Art Deco style that feels more private residence than grand hotel.
The building was once a private residence whose artwork attracted visits from Noel Coward and T.E. Lawrence.
The building on Park Lane used to be the home of the Playboy Club.
CUT at 45 Park Lane, an American steak restaurant, is Wolfgang Puck's first European restaurant.
Damien Hirst's Diamond Dust Psalms series hangs on the walls at CUT.
Sushi Kanesaka serves Edomae sushi as an omakase, with the chef choosing the fish, the order and the pace.
Sushi Kanesaka offers private dining for four diners at their own counter with their own private chef.
The spa features an indoor swimming pool, sauna, steam room, hydro pool and fully equipped gym.
The spa offers La Prairie treatments.

highlights.text: Sushi Kanesaka is chef Shinji Kanesaka's first European restaurant.
The hotel's permanent art collection includes works by Sir Peter Blake, Damien Hirst, Christian Furr and Joe Tilson.
The pool is set against a traditional Venetian floral mosaic.
Each guest has one host for the whole stay, acting as concierge, butler and bath preparer.

considerations.text: Sushi Kanesaka is considered suitable only for guests aged 12 and above.
WhataHotel notes the intimate boutique size means more limited facilities than larger hotels.
